item.title: Brookhaven And Stony Brook Researchers Demonstrate ‘Wireless’ Capability for Quantum Network
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Brookhaven National Laboratory and the State University of New York at Stony Brook (Stony Brook University) have successfully transmitted light particles containing quantum information through open air between the two institutions.
